data.one_liner: Sembast NoSQL database support built on top of sqflite for cross-process safety.
data.what_it_does: Provides a NoSQL document database API backed by an SQLite journaling layer. It enables fast in-memory access combined with cross-process safe database storage and transactions.
use_when: You need a NoSQL Sembast database interface that is cross-process safe.
You want fast in-memory NoSQL access backed by SQLite storage.
avoid_when: You are using multiple isolates to access the same sembast_sqflite database (it should be used from the main isolate only).
You want standard raw SQLite queries without a NoSQL abstraction layer.
strengths: Cross-process safe database storage and transaction mechanism.
Familiar Sembast NoSQL API backed by sqflite.
weaknesses: Should be used from the main isolate only.
Can encounter locked access if multiple transactions are in progress concurrently.
data.setup_notes: Follow setup instructions for platform-specific dependencies required by sqflite.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want traditional relational SQL storage instead of a NoSQL document API.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a robust, type-safe reactive SQL database library for Flutter.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a pure key-value NoSQL database without relying on an SQLite engine.
